title: A robust iterative scheme for the slightly compressible Darcy-Forchheimer equations
summary: We study the slightly compressible Darcy-Forchheimer equations modeling gas flow in porous media, particularly in applications related to combustion processes. The equations are discretized in time using the backward Euler method and in space via a mixed finite element scheme. As a result, a nonlinear algebraic system is obtained at each time step. We propose and analyze a general iterative linearization scheme for the efficient solution of such systems and study its convergence properties at the discrete level.
